title: Learning STM32? Any AI Tools or ChatGPT Tips for Beginners?
content:
Hi everyone,

I'm new to STM32 development and trying to learn embedded programming step by step. I've been using ChatGPT to understand concepts, debug code, and explain STM32CubeMX configurations in simple language, which has made learning much easier.

Do you use ChatGPT or any other AI tools while working with STM32 projects? If yes, how do you use them for debugging, code optimization, or understanding peripherals?

I'd love to hear your workflow and recommendations for beginners. Thanks!

scraped_replies.html: start practicing with deepblue embedded and controllerstech they give nice explanation and video

Do you use ChatGPT or any other AI tools while working with STM32 projects?

No.

The best tool for learning, debugging, code optimization, & understanding peripherals is the one between your ears!
